### 🟢 Approval recommended It is a documentation-only report with no code or runtime impact, its internal counts and arithmetic reconcile, and spot-checked PR/merge metadata matches GitHub ground truth. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR adds a single new documentation file recording the outcomes of the fixed `B1-cx` harness-eval trial. It is a pure record-keeping artifact under `docs/reports/harness-evals/` with no code, configuration, or runtime impact. The report captures per-item timestamps, PR/merge SHAs, CI run links, review rounds, earlier failed attempts, local baseline failures, smoke limitations, follow-ups, and isolation incidents for the ten queue items (nine merged into `trial/b1-cx`, one flagged blocked because its acceptance was already satisfied at T0). **Changes:** - Adds `REPORT.md` documenting ten trial queue items (9 merged, 1 blocked at item 8282). - Records gate evidence per item: reviewed heads, final-head CI counts, review dispositions, and attempt/correction counts. - Documents verification/delivery notes, earlier failed attempts, local suite baseline failures, smoke observations, incidents, and follow-ups. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | docs/​reports/​harness-evals/​trial/​runs/​B1-cx/​REPORT.md | New trial-outcome report; internally consistent and corroborated by GitHub PR metadata for the referenced merges. |
Review effort: Balanced
